en.headline: Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro pop-up ends today at Hysan Place
en.dek: The official merchandise store offering apparel, accessories and collectables from the films closes on Tuesday after a month-long run in Causeway Bay.
body: The Mahou Dokoro Harry Potter pop-up store at Hysan Place in Causeway Bay ends its run on Tuesday. Opened on 24 July, the temporary outlet has offered official apparel, accessories and other collectables inspired by the Harry Potter and Fantastic Beasts films.
The organiser said the store featured a fresh lineup of products for the Hong Kong return visit. Visitors could browse and purchase items during regular mall hours.
Mahou Dokoro is an official Harry Potter retail concept that has previously appeared in the city. The current edition is the final day for shoppers seeking the limited selection.

zh.headline: 哈利波特Mahou Dokoro期間限定店今日結束
zh.dek: 希慎廣場官方周邊店營業至今日，提供電影系列服裝、配件及收藏品。
body: 位於銅鑼灣希慎廣場的哈利波特Mahou Dokoro期間限定店今日（25日）結束營業。店舖自7月24日開業，售賣官方服裝、配件及其他來自哈利波特及怪獸系列電影的收藏品。
主辦方表示，今次回歸為顧客帶來全新產品系列。市民可於商場一般營業時間內進店選購。
Mahou Dokoro為哈利波特官方零售概念，曾在本港出現。今次為期一個月的限定店今日為最後營業日。
